note: Separate original Rust candle-core CPU package, without Python bindings or optional GPU backends. The pinned candidate preserves compatible versions from the earlier operator lock, including tokenizers 0.23.2 with fancy-regex and no default features. Its active graph contains no PyO3, target-lexicon or colored; it does not alter the independent catalog Tokenizers commit or clear its blocker. All 130 active registry checksums and selected original LICENSE bytes were checked and read. No source compiled or dependency build scripts run. Driver/API contract, full notice assessment, clean build, independent numeric oracle, Engine privacy projection and joined CLI/MCP/restart acceptance are still pending. This review does not count as an implementation.
